title: Cam kenarı

characters.BRO: a boy of about ten with messy brown hair, wearing a green raincoat
characters.SIS: a girl of about eight with a short black bob, wearing a red raincoat
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-two with messy brown hair, wearing a green parka
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with a short black bob, wearing a red wool coat

scenes.text:
Kardeşinle en büyük kavganız
neden hep cam kenarı içindi?
scenes.prompt: In the back seat of an old family car on a rainy day, {BRO} on the left and {SIS} on the right sit side by side, both leaning toward the same window and pouting at each other, raindrops on the glass.

scenes.text:
Yol uzundu, cam tekti;
dünya oradan görünüyordu.
scenes.prompt: A winding country road through golden autumn hills seen from a car window, light rain, a faint rainbow over the trees. No people.

scenes.text:
Sonunda biri uyuyakalır,
öbür sessizce cama geçerdi.
scenes.prompt: At dusk in the back seat of the car, {SIS} is asleep with her head resting on the shoulder of {BRO}, who looks out the window with a quiet smile, soft orange light.

scenes.text:
Şimdi ayrı şehirlerde,
kendi arabanızda tek başınasınız.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night, {MAN} sits alone in the driver's seat of a car parked by the roadside, looking out the wet window, blurred city lights.

scenes.text:
Bir yolculuk planla, cam kenarı ona kalsın.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn road at sunset, {MAN} drives on the left laughing, while {WOMAN} sits in the passenger seat on the right leaning toward the open window with a big smile, golden leaves blowing.

caption:
Cam kenarı kimindi?

Kavga ettiğiniz o koltuk şimdi çok boş. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
